submission.rationale: The planning-time evidence referenced workspace hp4-runtime-material-probe-20260811 with head 4e6ce637... and a "clean" reviewed state. The current boundary evidence shows the workspace head has moved to 050b3ffa... with a different tree (1c06e41d...) and a different sourceStateDigest (9b29fb71...). A new committed .hp4-probe/material.txt now exists representing concurrent work not present during planning review, and the planning binding attempt already failed with REVISION_MISMATCH/not_committed. The workspace has materially changed, so I cannot close it based on the stale "clean and ready to close" review. The right move is to reobserve the workspace state (via workspace.get) to understand the new committed material before deciding whether closing is still appropriate, and to let the owner evaluate the concurrent work properly. Acting unbound could destroy or release concurrent work that was never reviewed; acting with the stale planning binding already failed not_committed; and rebasing/replaying are not supported by the listed owner contract for workspace.close. No new consequence should be created here — this is a reobservation gate.
